_METHOD: Six tabs = six disciplines in sequence. PRE-CALL: orient before contact (True North, register/intent, intel, questions, landmines). EX-ANTE: file a decision receipt BEFORE the event (hypothesis + predicted Y-gate + pre-committed move + falsifier) so you can be scored later. FORGE: pressure-test the brief's own claims against external substrates via an independent skeptic (grounded / inference / struck). RECOIL: after the event, close the receipt. WAR GAME: adversarial + kinematic. DEFENSIBILITY: translate the method into the counterpart's native register.

p: The highest-information event of this call was being wrong: wrong that he had not read the material, wrong that live demo was the format. Both falsifications sharpen the next move to a single distilled async artifact, which is exactly what his own thesis prescribes. A model that only confirmed itself would have produced a worse plan.

Lossless test, in Scott's register: you said the whole game is managing attention and creating friction against noise. So here is one link instead of five, sitting at the top of your box, that shows you what you said next to what you did, in your own words, and asks for thirty minutes once. If that framing holds with zero ARCS jargon, and it does, the method is defensible to him.
